items.title: Drink Nuka-Cola Quantum
items.detail: Get from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in your C.A.M.P.

items.title: Build a Generator in a C.A.M.P. or Workshop
items.detail: Open C.A.M.P. build menu, navigate to Power and place any Generator.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted weapons, junk, chems, or food to a vendor at train stations.

items.title: Cripple a Super Mutant's Leg
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center and cripple a Super Mutant's Leg.

items.title: Eat a box of Blamco Brand Mac and Cheese
items.detail: Find a box at Grafton Dam rowboat or Watoga Underground diner storeroom.

items.title: Kill a Super Mutant
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center for reliable spawns.

items.title: Take a Camera Picture of a Super Mutant
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center, equip Camera and photograph a Super Mutant.

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your Shelter, access build menu and place any decoration from Decorations category.

items.title: Buy an item from or Sell an item to another Player
items.detail: Visit another player's C.A.M.P. and buy or sell at their vendor.

items.title: Collect Caps
items.detail: Sell looted items to vendors or collect from world containers.

items.title: Complete an Event or Activity
items.detail: Public Events spawn server-wide every 20 minutes with yellow Event icons.

items.title: Complete an Infestation
items.detail: Find gray cloudy Infestation area on map, locate hotspot and clear all enemies including boss.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Start a Head Hunt at Highway Town Bounty Board to trigger the encounter.

items.title: Kill a Mutated Enemy
items.detail: Join a Mutated Public Event marked with green hexagon DNA icon on map.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Pint-Sized Phantoms are masked cultists that can appear during Infestations.

items.title: Kill a Legendary Creature
items.detail: Join public events like Radiation Rumble or trigger Leader of the Pack at Tyler County Fairgrounds.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Special mutated public events with exclusive mutant enemy packages as rewards.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Double experience weekend with XP buffs during the specified period.

events.name: World Pets Update (Patch 72) / Season 27 Start
events.description: Major update introducing world pets and beginning of Season 27.

events.name: Treasure Hunter and Double Mutations
events.description: Treasure Hunter event with double mutation chance in encounters.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Holiday-themed scorched enemy event with festive rewards and gifts.
